## 03 — Opening family and both alpha positions

Crop `readers/026/A/crop_02_family.png`; SHA-256 `2d1aee1051346817db7b57e8653329fe34871111a042fbbd5a403c8d87615273`. Loci: S01, L003.

Inside the two parentheses, the Sigma has a short dark horizontal upper run separated by white paper from the descending upper diagonal and lower zigzag/foot. A looped alpha is written above-right and another looped alpha below-right; the lower one is not omitted. After the closing parenthesis a third alpha precedes the membership sign. The final family sign has a tall double-curved E-like body, a low loop and a long rightward foot. Its calligraphic/script alphabet remains underdetermined at this resolution. Retain the complete Sigma-alpha-alpha state and the local upper-run qualification from A; retain both its glyph-head and independent-run alternatives without assigning the independent run a named hand. The family sign keeps mathcal E first, mathscr E and varepsilon alternatives, and should use B's exact EFAM literal drawing so its observed loop and foot remain represented. C026-R01 stays retained. The visible alpha placements and membership are high confidence; the head attachment and family alphabet are medium confidence. H's opening occurrence lacks the lower alpha present in the crop.
